content_of_post_to_answer: Why do we make our minds strong?
answer: We make our minds strong not to stop feeling pain, fear, or disappointment, but to prevent those feelings from making every decision for us. Mental strength is not the absence of vulnerability; it is the ability to experience something difficult without immediately reacting to it. There is a difference between being emotionally numb and being emotionally steady. I explore this distinction further in some of my other writing on my profile. A strong mind doesn't feel less; it learns not to be ruled by everything it feels.
